considerations: Boots but is heavily lagging all the time
It is technically playable if you are fine with 9 fps but i wouldnt say its a fun experience

In older versions, simply changing the CPU overclock was enough to achieve a considerable FPS gain in the game. In these newer versions, this has been fixed; however, other settings have been added that significantly slow down the system. The configuration I'm using gives me around 15 FPS in the game and much more fluidity.
